name: Gorgora
description: Historic town on the northern shore of Lake Tana, known for monasteries, birdlife, and boat trips.

name: Lalibela
description: Rock-hewn churches and a major Ethiopian Orthodox pilgrimage destination.

name: Gondar
description: Former imperial capital known for Fasil Ghebbi castle compound and Debre Berhan Selassie church.

name: Bahir Dar
description: Lakeside city on Lake Tana, gateway to the Blue Nile Falls and island monasteries.

name: Axum
description: Ancient Aksumite capital with stelae fields, churches, and archaeological sites.

name: Harar
description: Walled historic city in eastern Ethiopia, known for the Jegol, coffee culture, and hyena feeding.

name: Simien Mountains
description: UNESCO national park with escarpments, gelada baboons, and highland trekking.

name: Addis Ababa
description: Capital city and main gateway, with museums, markets, and Bole airport transfers.

name: Omo Valley
description: Southern Ethiopia cultural region known for markets and community visits around Jinka.

name: Danakil Depression
description: Otherworldly Afar desert of volcanoes, salt flats, and colorful hydrothermal springs around Erta Ale and Dallol.
